---
title: "Datasets"
jupyter: python3
---

Four datasets ship with the package. Each is read on first use and returned as a
fresh copy, so editing one in a script never changes the next.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from ezrsurvey.datasets import DATASET_DOCS, DATASET_NAMES, load_dataset

for name in DATASET_NAMES:
    heading, _, body = DATASET_DOCS[name].partition("\n\n")
    print(f"## `{name}`\n\n**{heading}**\n\n{body}\n")
    print(load_dataset(name).head(3).to_markdown(index=False))
    print()
```
